featured_reviews.review_text:

I would definitely recommend Mahakali to anyone looking for quality books at great prices.

featured_reviews.review_text: The owner and his son are so arrogant and rude that you will be appalled. You will be insulted left, right and centre. featured_reviews.name: Sachin Gupta
featured_reviews.review_text: This Book Point shop is by far the worst I've ever encountered. The owner is not only rude but also incredibly slow; I was next in line to pick up my kid books, and it took over 30 minutes! It seems like the owner enjoys arguing about every little thing rather than focusing on running his business. I made my payment through a QR code with a RuPay credit card, only to be told later that I had to pay extra because I used a credit card. I chose not to argue because I figured my time was better spent elsewhere than giving him ammunition for another argument, which seems to be his favorite pastime. I did mention to him that it would have been better if he had informed me of this beforehand or at least disabled the credit card payment option. Charging customers for bank processing fees is not just unethical—it's a complete offense. But I’ve learned that arguing with fools only leads to frustration. Do yourself a favor—steer clear of this Book Point shop!

featured_reviews.review_text:
Only a bookstore. Also this book store only caters to SCHOOL TEXTBOOKS. Many schools use their services to provide academic textbooks. We had purchased the academic years textbooks from the school. Once I showed the missing pages to the person at the counter, he was kind enough to acknowledge the mistake. featured_reviews.review_text: Hands down the best bookstore in Mumbai. Been here a few times now, and I can say that the collection of books along with the quiet, peaceful atmosphere is unmatched anywhere else.

featured_reviews.name: Qurratulain Parihar
featured_reviews.review_text: My friend took me here for the 1st time today and I was amazed!! Even though it's a smaller book store, somehow there is an endless variety of books and so many different genres!! So many beautiful covers and attractive titles I saw today. All of them organized and aligned neatly. Its such a quiet & cozy little nook in the loud market of Andheri, I could spend hours in here. Needless to say I will come back to purchase books especially from the impressive children's selection for my little brother♡ It inspired me to start a collection of my own, my empty shelves are catching dust😅

featured_reviews.name: Supriya J
featured_reviews.review_text: This bookstore is my childhood... the reason why I am a book lover is because of Book Lovers! I recently visited after several years, and I got a huge hit of nostalgia, because it felt like nothing had changed (in the best way possible!). The store still has a wonderful collection of books, you could get lost there for hours.

featured_reviews.review_text:
One of the only surviving book stores in Bombay. My go to place for any book I want to read.
It’s a smallish shop (like most in Andheri) but they’ve managed to fill it with as many books possible.
You can get books from all genres here and can also order some books that they might not have in stock.
Places like this just take the cultural value of the neighbourhood up.

featured_reviews.name: Sachin Khot
featured_reviews.review_text: Been visiting here since 2001 & they have a wonderful collection and they can order for you if the book is not in stock... For a period of time I was in Jakarta & I used to order books from them & they used to courier the books to me.  Have a great relationship with Book Lovers at a time when the book shops are wanning in the city.  Over the years many of their staff has changed but whomsoever the new person he is courteous  & polite.... The owner Mani sir is available for a quick chat if you visit the shop & is a affable gentleman...
